$comment: Coverage floor for npm run coverage:check. Measured on the commit that added it.
This RATCHETS UP ONLY. Raise the floors when coverage improves; never lower one
to make a run pass -- a red check means coverage regressed, fix the tests.
Floors sit 1 point below the measured figure: the merged per-file-process run
is not bit-identical between invocations (observed drift: 62.93 vs 62.92).
Numbers come from coverage/coverage-summary.json; see .c8rc.json for what is
excluded and why, and docs/testing.md for the procedure.
2026-09-01, releasing the last 5 quarantined files: the BRANCH floor was
lowered 77.80 -> 76.40 with --force. That is not a regression. V8 emits no
granular branch records for a file nothing exercises, so an unrun file used to
contribute its lines to the denominator but almost no branches -- DirAiCondition
reported 1/1 branches, DirAiPrompt 1/1, DirAskGPTV2 2/2, i.e. a fake 100%. Now
that those files actually run they report 54, 78 and 98 branches. Covered
branches ROSE 1552 -> 1845 and not one file lost a covered branch; the
percentage fell only because the denominator became honest (1969 -> 2381).
Same artefact family as the class-initialiser merge documented in
scripts/coverage.js. Verified by running the full coverage report at 6cd0e653
and diffing per file.
2026-09-01, after fixing three catalogued runtime defects: the utils floor
was re-recorded 83.60 -> 83.50 with --force. NOT a regression. The 84.66
figure recorded at dfc6a990 never matched reality: checking out the source
files at 3f93eaaf and removing the new tests measures utils at 84.54,
identical to HEAD. The stale 0.12 was blocking every future --update.
2026-09-01, coverage wave 1 (tiledesk/bot/agents): the utils floor moved down
0.10 again under --force. Same documented merge drift, not a regression:
measuring HEAD with the new tests stashed gives utils 1427/1662 = 85.86%,
byte-identical per file to the run with them. Forcing here LOCKS IN the real
gains (agents 34->99.00, bot 32->96.46, tiledesk 50->96.85) which would
otherwise stay unratcheted because one unrelated area sampled 0.10 low.

2026-09-01, fixing the catalogued runtime defects: no floor was forced. Worth recording that utils/ChatbotReplyUtil.js drifts by 2 lines (254 vs 256 of 302) between otherwise identical runs, i.e. ~0.12 points on the utils area. That is the same per-file-process merge noise the headroom exists for; a run that samples low is not a regression, re-measure before reaching for --force.

2026-09-01, stage 1 of the final wave: the 12 catalogued runtime defects fixed and their it.skip() tests released, plus 4 new tests for the unhandled rejection raised by the checkMandatoryParameters abort. No floor was forced -- every floor ratcheted UP. Overall lines 91.97 -> 92.22, directives/ai 96.40 -> 97.14, directives/data 96.19 -> 97.67. The line TOTAL grew (19857 -> 19979) because the fixes add real error-handling code, so a rising percentage here is a genuine gain twice over.

2026-09-01, stage 2 of the final wave (integrations + utils): no floor forced, every floor ratcheted UP. directives/integrations 74.04 -> 96.92, utils 87.50 -> 97.60, overall 92.22 -> 94.26. The integrations ratchet was deferred one commit because utils sampled 87.38 against its 86.50 floor on that run (the ChatbotReplyUtil merge drift already recorded above); the new utils tests removed the drift's headroom problem outright.

2026-09-01, stage 2 (engine): engine 71.16 -> 96.37, overall 94.26 -> 96.21. No floor forced. The two Mongo-backed sources are covered by stubbing the mongoose MODELS (Faq.find / Faq_kb.findById) rather than by connecting: the suite still never talks to MongoDB, which is what .c8rc.json and docker-compose.test.yml assume.

2026-09-01, stage 2 (platform layer): cache 84.53 -> 93.37, engine/mock 88.32 -> 98.13, variables 86.52 -> 99.29, expressions 94.83 -> 96.95; overall 96.21 -> 96.60. No floor forced. The TdCache tests talk to the same redis the suite already needs (REDIS_HOST/REDIS_PORT); every key they touch is namespaced under their own request id and deleted in after().

2026-09-01, stage 2 (observability): Logger 55 -> 100, the area 76.06 -> 100.00 lines / 46.15 -> 100 functions; overall 96.60 -> 96.82. No floor forced. The publishing half of Logger only exists when FLOW_LOGS_ENABLED and AMQP_MANAGER_URL are set at REQUIRE time, so logger_units_test.js sets them for itself and stubs Publisher.prototype.publish before requiring Logger. Nothing connects to a broker.

2026-09-01, stage 3a (the MongoDB boot path and the message pipeline): overall lines 96.82 -> 97.54, startApp/index 74.38 -> 100.00, pipeline 96.88 -> 100.00, pipeline/plugs 89.21 -> 98.83, routes 92.91 -> 95.63, engine 96.37 -> 97.02. No floor forced. Two new files. test/startapp_mongo_test.js is the ONE file that boots the connector WITHOUT settings.bots: it connects to the mongo of docker-compose.test.yml on its own database (tilebot_startapp_test, dropped in after()), seeds a faq_kb and its faqs through the real models, and drives POST /ext/:botid and /exec/:botid through the Mongo data source and the IntentsMachineFactory. It must stay the only one -- mongoose has a single default connection per process, and the per-file process isolation of scripts/run-tests.js is what keeps the other 85 files on their static-bot contract. test/pipeline_units_test.js runs each plug inside a real MessagePipeline and asserts on the resolved message and on what the mock server received. Overall BRANCH coverage rose 93.95 -> 94.31 even though the engine area's branch figure fell 97.37 -> 96.17: newly-executed code makes previously-invisible branches countable, the same denominator effect recorded above for the quarantine release.

2026-09-01, stage 3b (the last gap to 98%): overall lines 97.54 -> 98.06, branches 94.31 -> 95.19, functions 97.76 -> 97.90. No floor forced -- every floor ratcheted UP. Four new unit files, all additive: base_directive_units_test.js (BaseDirective 92.75 -> 100: the four branch x connected combinations of _executeCondition and the completion callback), http_clients_units_test.js (HttpUtils/utils.http's https agent, TdCache.connect(callback), the BASE_URL/API_URL request attributes), when_expression_corners_test.js (TiledeskWhenExpression 93.9 -> 99.4: string escapes, exponent literals, the parser's two syntax errors, optional-chained indexing, unary +/-, isEmpty on scalars) and directive_gaps_units_test.js (DirForm past the first question 86.9 -> 100, plus the success-with-no-trueIntent branch of Customerio/Hubspot and a web request over https).

Areas still under 98% after stage 3b, with the reason. Each remaining line was read; what is left is predominantly UNREACHABLE, not untested: routes/parametersRoutes.js 29-31/62-64 test `allParametersStatic() === null`, which RequestParameters can never return (it always resolves an object), and 45-47 tests an empty `:requestid`, which express cannot route; DirMake 114-131 and DirWebRequestV2 130-141 are the `if (err)` halves of two services documented in the source itself as never producing an err; DirAddTags 80-82/90-92/126-128/136-138 need addNewTag()/updateRequestWithTags() to return falsy, which they cannot because httpUtils.request already reports an empty 2xx body as an error; DirCondition 65-69 tests `scriptCondition.trim === ""` -- a comparison against the FUNCTION, never true; DirIfOpenHours 46-49 and DirIteration's Object.entries/Object.keys/Symbol.iterator fallbacks are unreachable for the same class of reason (a const reassignment that would throw, and branches masked by an earlier equivalent test). PromptManager 45-49 is the fallback for a prompt file that is always present on disk.

2026-09-02, the last seven catalogued runtime defects: no floor forced -- every floor ratcheted UP (overall lines 98.06 -> 98.15, branches 95.19 -> 95.31, directives/integrations lines 97.79 -> 98.05 with its floor 96.7 -> 97, engine/mock 98.13 -> 99.09 with floor 97.1 -> 98). The fixes: the two ChatbotParametersClient failure tests released against the ff512d35 source fix, winston required in MockBotsDataSource, DirBrevo's missing-key guard given the return it never had, DirMake routed on the status the webhook answered instead of always on the true connector, DirSendWhatsapp's absent payload guarded, and DirWhatsappByAttribute's vestigial reject() removed. Two per-area BRANCH figures sampled ~0.1 low and are recorded as measured, not forced: cache 95.45 -> 95.35 (a single file, TdCache.js, untouched by this work -- 41/43 against the 42/44 recorded before) and engine 96.21 -> 96.20. Both are the per-file-process merge drift already documented above; the line figures for both areas ROSE over the same run.
